item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:

Germany and Ukraine are testing an armed ground robot for frontline deployment. US pressure has led Ukraine to pause strikes on Russian refineries, and Trump officials are discussing sanctions relief for a Russian fund. The localized ceasefire in Oleshky entered its third day.

item.description:

The federal government has agreed to acquire Pakistani JF‑17 fighter jets, the United States has imposed entry conditions on ships calling at Somali ports, and the UAE has carried out its first drone strike against Al Shabaab in nearly a year. Piracy off Somalia’s coast is rising, with hijacked oil tankers and hostages reported, and the US military has been accused of trapping civilians in flood-affected areas and of weaponising El Niño against Somali civilians. The conflict caused 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
